acceptance_rules: height difference requires two actual bound elevations
EA dataset RMSE is not replaced by ground-truth point accuracy
shared LiDAR lineage is treated as correlated rather than independent
OSTN15/OSGM15 transformation error remains separate from terrain surface error
Terrain50 4m RMSE is corroboration context rather than candidate primary uncertainty
survey/title epoch mismatch is retained as a quality flag
no height difference is emitted when either elevation is missing
quality_effect: Adds independence-aware, datum-aware and epoch-aware acceptance before any candidate pair height difference can be emitted.
